overview: A 20-year-old photo foretells gruesome deaths. Qin Ming must uncover the truth: fate, curse, or calculated murder?
title: Once Upon a Time in Longfan

overview: Lu Wuyi, the youngest nine-tailed fox of the mysterious Formless Moon Sect, sets out on a mission with her friend Wu Wangyan to track down a fox demon on the run, Xiaowei. She infiltrates the Wei Mansion in Luo'an City, where she later crosses paths with Wu Shiguang, who holds a deep grudge, as well as Ji Ling and Li Jie, demon hunters from the Shilin Sect. In the process of uncovering the truth, they navigate between suspicion and cooperation, each driven by their own agendas. In their repeated struggles over the Dragon Deity's Power, their fates are changed time and again. To preserve peace in the world, they make painful sacrifices and ultimately subdue Jiu Ying, the lord of all demons, thus fulfilling an enduring quest of love and redemption.
title: Veil of Shadows

overview: Airing every Saturday and Sunday, this hosted programming block encourages preschoolers to ask questions, be curious about the world around them and participate in a daily musical adventure. Host Miles and his puppy friend Banjo, an adorable and spirited puppet who loves to play her homemade banjo, embark each afternoon on a musical journey. Miles loves to sing, discover new things and connect with viewers to help them learn through humor, music and interactive play. Always ready for adventure, Banjo represents the wonder, energy and curiosity of a preschooler. The show also weaves in episodes of kids' favorite shows, including Bob The Builder,™ and Angelina Ballerina™.
title: The Let's Go Show

overview: The documentary work of British-American journalist Louis Theroux.
title: Louis Theroux

overview: Norway's most read blogger Caroline Berg Eriksen, last year's "New Girl" Karn Kjerstad and lifestyle blogger Espen Hilton are looking for "The New Girl 2014".
title: Det Nye-jenta

overview: Per Aarhaug was born in Cameroon in Africa and has lived there most of his life. His parents were Norwegian missionaries. Per grew up close to nature and early on became fond of everything that lives - animals, plants and people. As a young man, Per traveled to Norway to study medicine. When he returned to Cameroon, he was shocked by what met him. Poaching, overgrazing, deforestation and predatory exploitation of natural resources were on the way to destroying the country.
title: Doktor Per

overview: "Birken" is the name of the new folk disease - over sixty thousand Norwegians are affected. Who are they? What do they want? What drives them?
title: Drømmen om Birken

overview: A feast for the senses. The Michelin-starred chef celebrates the south of France, unlocking the secrets of simple, seasonal cuisine - and adding a British twist to the classics.
title: Marcus Wareing Simply Provence

overview: We bring you the most spectacular moments from Ekstremsportveko on Voss - with parachute, river kayaking, dead-singing, longboarding and much more.
title: Ekstremsportveko

overview: In 2018, the former biathlete president Anders Besseberg is charged with corruption and for having hidden Russian doping. The documentary series shows a hitherto unknown side of Europe's biggest winter sport.
title: En varslet skandale

overview: What now, America? Exit Trump follows the aftermath of a very special presidency. While Donald Trump is being impeached for the second time, President Joe Biden will lead a United States where the challenges are lined up. "Exit Trump" is an informal current affairs program with exciting guests and a good mood, which makes you a little wiser.
title: Exit Trump

overview: In two programmes, you can join Arne Hjeltnes on a journey from the dangerous and colorful Lofoten fishing, to a food festival in Italy and culinary food experiences in the dried fish nation of Nigeria.
title: Fisken som bygde landet

overview: Three years ago, Erik Follestad Johansen put his skates on the shelf. In these years he has been an expert, but now he will lace up his skates again to show Norway that he is still good enough. Follestad takes us inside the clubs in the top division, tells unknown stories and will try to fit into the team. Whether he gets a contract or not is up to the coaches. Will he be successful, or have three years of celebrity life and minimal training turned "Folle" into an amateur?
title: Follestad gjør ting han kunne før

overview: Sports and business intersect in the recruitment of high-school athletes, removing the competition from the field or court and bringing it into family rooms all across the country. As coaches make their pitches to athletes and their families, ESPN Recruiting Nation is on the trail as well with this weekly studio show that delves into high-school athletes and their potential impact on the college scene. The hourlong program also provides inside information surrounding recruiting news and features analysis from a staff of national and regional experts, including Tom Luginbill, Craig Haubert, Jamie Newberg and Corey Long.
title: ESPN Recruiting Nation

overview: Make-up is no longer just foundation and mascara, and never before has interest in advanced make-up been greater. Join the hunt for Norway's next makeup star!
title: Glow Up

overview: Simon Nitsche and Magnus Midtbø meet for a boundless duel in Telemark. Can the sports anchor beat the athlete and be left with the trophy at Gaustatoppen?
title: Grenseløse Telemark

overview: Illustrator Gunvor Rasmussen, carpenter Julian Simon and landscape gardener Steven Stiberg Long are the three-leaf clover who, together with various designers, will fix the gardens of different families. They are given free rein to spruce up people's gardens - and they have to do it in four days.
title: Hagetid

overview: Katarina Flatland occupies celebrities' houses with a team of designers and workers to refurbish a room. Parallel to the renovation, we get to know the celebrity's life and career through conversations and activities together with Katarina.
title: Heder og Hammer

overview: Tale Maria Krohn Engvik is the public health nurse who decided to reach out more widely to young people by communicating with them in their own arena. With a mix of serious knowledge, humor and personality, she reaches up to 150,000 viewers on Snapchat daily. Now she has created a TV series for and with young people where difficult and taboo topics such as sex, the body, nude images, suicidal thoughts and heartbreak are addressed in a simple and harmless way.
title: Helsesista

overview: We have gathered a professional styling team with experts in clothes, make-up and hair whose goal is simple: They will prove that it is possible to transform a lucky woman and give her a new and cooler style. And they only need 100 minutes!
title: Helt ny på 100 minutter

overview: In this Norwegian documentary series, we follow children with heart disease in their everyday lives. We get to see how they are with their families at home and how they prepare for vital operations at Oslo University Hospital Rikshospitalet.
title: Hjertebarna

overview: Hop Stars is a basketball team from Bergen for players with special needs - and who need tailored training. In autumn 2022, the team got to represent Norway in a major Special Olympics tournament in Italy. We follow the players in their everyday lives, both at home and at work, on the way to the games in Tuscany.
title: Hop Stars

overview: In this show, a hidden camera is used to test people's helpfulness, and the question is quite simple - who cares?
title: Hvem bryr seg

overview: Based on her own life, presenter Marthe Sveberg seeks answers to questions she is not alone in asking: How can I make my marriage last? When will I stop hating my own appearance? Do I have a normal relationship with my family? Why does the job make me so vulnerable? In the search for answers, Marthe meets people with quite different answers and experiences.
title: Hvordan overleve

overview: The ANOC Awards was held for the first time in Bangkok in 2014 and has been held every year since then. The event was created in order to recognise and honour the achievements of the NOCs and their athletes as well as distinguished members of the Olympic Family. Held each year, the event is an opportunity for the world's NOCs come together in a relaxed and entertaining environment and enjoy an evening celebrating sport.
title: The ANOC Awards

overview: Charlotte Mohn and Hedda Kise are on a cycle tour - in known and unknown places, meet known and unknown people and take part in exciting activities.
title: Jenter på hjul

overview: We follow nine people of different ages who have been diagnosed with cancer. The series gives a close and personal picture of the course of their illness and how cancer affects their lives and those close to them.
title: Kampen for livet

overview: From the shores of Sicily to the heights of the Apennine Mountains, Eyewitness WWII: Invasion Italy captures the stories of those who experienced the harrowing two-year campaign first-hand and highlights the importance that hard-fought battles in Italy and the Mediterranean played in the ultimate outcome of the war.
title: Eyewitness WWII: Invasion Italy

overview: Four famous people will run a restaurant for four days. The celebrities will take turns in the roles of cook, waiter, cleaning help and restaurant manager. Who makes the funnest concept? And who serves the best food?
title: Kjendisrestauranten

overview: Piers Morgan interviews some of the most infamous murderers in the U.S. Featuring some of the nation's most fiercely contested cases, exclusive interviews, and sensational revelations, these convicted killers all have one thing in common; they insist they are innocent. In a close-quarters, one hour interview, this is the murderer's chance to give their side of the story.
title: The Killer Interview with Piers Morgan

overview: Adapted from Chen Yanyi's new social school suspense novel "The Perfect Suspect", the story begins with a seemingly flawless crime that unravels the 'pathology' of human nature beneath the surface. Intertwined with a case involving children, it serves as a mirror reflecting the many faces of society.
title: The Perfect Suspect

overview: The 1970s ushered in a travel revolution – suddenly Britain was saying ‘adios' to wet weekends by the sea, and jetting off to package destinations on the Costas that weren't even built yet! This two-part series takes a step back in time to when all of this was thrillingly new – when sangria, pesetas and siestas became part of our vocab; when holiday brochures dominated our doormats; and holiday programmes took over the airways. We take modern holiday makers on a trip down memory lane, in a recreated high street travel agency, and aboard an authentic 1970s plane. We uncover a secret history of backrooms deals with dictatorships that helped finance our favourite resorts, as well as holiday deals and food options that you wouldn't get nowadays. From mass travel to hippy trail wanderlust, this show takes us back to the decade that started it all.
title: Holidaying in the 70s: Wish You Were Here

overview: The latest political and socio-economic news and updates from around the world, live.
title: Fox News Live

overview: "Good Fortunes" is a business and financial talk show where the world's richest people under 40 discuss their desire and need to improve society.
title: Good Fortunes

overview: A story that begins when you think it's over... An extraordinary love affair despite all odds in a coastal town in the Aegean... A 38-year-old woman and an 18-year-old man: Reyan and Uzer
title: RU

overview: Comedians are given a thousand dollars to spend on their friends and their wildest dreams.
title: Thousandaires

overview: The Bible-teaching ministry of Pastor James MacDonald, emphasizing the precise exposition of God's Word and its practical life application. James MacDonald is the Senior Pastor of Harvest Bible Chapel in Chicago, Ill.
title: James MacDonald - Walk in the Word

overview: The Crow Girl begins with the gruesome discovery of a teenage boy's body discarded in plain sight. Determined to find who is responsible, DCI Jeanette Kilburn joins forces with psychotherapist Dr Sophia Craven to hunt the killer despite opposition from her superiors including confidant DI Lou Stanley. The investigation takes them into a dangerous world of historic abuse and murder. Together they uncover a chain of shocking events involving the disappearance of children that have gone overlooked for decades, as well as evidence of police corruption. As the body count rises and the two women are dragged into the depths of the murders, an intimacy starts to form between them, and so begins a complex, twisted love story. All the while, the killer is inching ever closer to home.
title: The Crow Girl

overview: Traitor/Patriot gives you an insider's look at the motivation behind the people who committed espionage.
title: Traitor/Patriot

overview: An apparently orphaned boy is taken in and raised by a Chinese gentleman named Po Chang. The boy, named Frank Garlund, and whose ancestry remains a mystery, becomes, by age thirty, a financial wizard, a youthful tycoon, who is also a key figure in worldwide business affairs In flashback sequences, events in the lives of the people who had come into contact with Garlund in his struggle to reach the top are dramatized.
title: Mr. Garlund

overview: We follow mums of different ages and get to take part in their small and big challenges in everyday life. A steady stream of other mothers comment and share experiences. "Kjære mamma" is an expert-free, feel-good series about what it really means to be a mother today.
title: Kjære mamma

overview: Three former "Jakten på kjærligheten" profiles move into a beautiful farm. Here they will meet 15 suitors with whom they will blind date, and live with for a period of time. There will be dating, barn dancing and fun - and maybe some surprises. Everyone wants to find that great love, will it be a match or will they end up single?
title: Kjærlighet til alle

overview: How It's Made is the addictive assembly line series that returns to give viewers an exclusive look at how their favorite items are manufactured. The series visits dozens of factories where raw materials transform into final products in the scope of a 30-minute episode.
title: How It's Made

overview: NBA Tonight is a highlights, news and information show -- regularly airing late night on ESPN2 -- is predominantly hosted by Cassidy Hubbarth. A rotating roster of analysts includes Tim Legler, Bruce Bowen, Antonio Davis, P.J. Carlesimo and George Karl, who break down all the action, comment on league business and discuss who's hot and who's not.
title: NBA Tonight

overview: Cooking competition where ten of the country's best chefs settle in a manor house to compete in classic cooking skills!
title: Kokkenes kamp

overview: Four of Norway's best comedians are going on tour throughout Norway, and on the road they will develop the show together. But can the four strong individualists work so closely together? And are they still mates at the end of the road?
title: Komikameratene

overview: Impersonator king Kasper Foss's big dream is to become a real football commentator. In this series, we follow Kasper's journey towards the big baptism of fire: his very own match in the Obosligaen. On the way, Kasper seeks out several of his own idols in the field. What is in the DNA of a solid sports commentator? And what must Kasper take with him if he is to live his dream?
title: Kommentatorskolen

overview: A series about short people in Norway, outsiders, prejudices and how you can find your own way even if you feel different.
title: Kort og lovende

overview: Join the crown prince couple as they show us their Norway, in the year they both turn 50. On the way, we get to know the Crown Prince couple better, who they are, and what engages them. On the journey, they meet people where they are, often on home visits.
title: Kronprinsparet – vårt Norge

overview: Our body is absolutely amazing, but how does it really work? The half hour of information has arrived. We clear up myths, test limits and show you how the body actually works.
title: Kroppen din

overview: Trond and Rune were born and raised by the coast, and love everything it offers in terms of exciting experiences and wonderful ingredients. The mountain goat Margit, on the other hand, gets seasick just at the thought, and with the boys as teachers, she gets to try everything that a land crab can't really do anything about. Together they will seek out culinary experiences along the southern coast. "Kystmat" with Rune & Margit & Moi offers spontaneous comedy, magnificent nature, exciting experiences and master cooking in a delightful mix.
title: Kystmat

overview: All over Norway there are entrepreneurs who are working hard to make their dreams come true. Who has what it takes? And how much are they willing to sacrifice?
title: Made in Norway

overview: Nattarbeiderne is a series with a high pace and a lot of drama. During the series, we get to know security guards, crime photographers, the military police, the emergency room in Drammen, the MMA fighter, the loggers, the VG editors, the Burlesque school and many more.
title: Nattarbeiderne

overview: Inside the NBA is the postgame show for NBA on TNT broadcasts. The program features host Ernie Johnson with analysts Charles Barkley, Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. Occasionally, Johnson, Smith, Barkley, and O'Neal are joined by analysts Chris Webber and Grant Hill. The show has won nine Emmy Awards, Ernie has won three as a studio host and Charles Barkley has won two as a studio analyst.
title: Inside the NBA

overview: How does it go when ex-minister Per Sandberg and former Miss Iran, Bahareh Letnes, take over the Grand Bar and Hotel in the border town of Halden?
title: Per og Baharehs Grand Hotel

overview: Påskereisen is a meeting between two people with very different life situations. A journey from city to mountain brings them together. Easter is the setting for the journey. There will be touching moments and good conversations. Charlotte Mohn Gaustad dishes up delicious Easter food. The series ends in Tøyenkirken with an Easter dinner accompanied by Jonas Fjeld.
title: Påskereisen

overview: Two design teams will compete to decorate a room. With zero kroner in the budget, they will create a concept each, then they find used things at recycling centers and finn.no, among others, which they use to create beautiful designer furniture.
title: Redesign

overview: In Reisen til Love Island, we follow presenter Morten Hegseth in his preparations for the job that awaits him when he will lead this winter's big venture Love Island.
title: Reisen til Love Island

overview: Norwegian interior program which aims to help all viewers interested in interior design to create a living and personal home - without costing the shirt!
title: rom123

overview: Betray your country, save the world. Spies and traitors play a dangerous game in the 1980s as the Cold War brings two superpowers to the brink of nuclear war.
title: Secrets & Spies: A Nuclear Game

overview: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard some of the world's fastest theme park rides and discovers how these rides affect the human body.
title: Science of Thrills

overview: In 1986, Tsunojima Island was home to the Decagonal House, a strange mansion with a decagonal appearance. The genius architect who built the mansion, Nakamura Seiji, died mysteriously in the burnt-down main building, Aoyashiki. Six months later, seven members of the University Mystery Research Club visit Tsunojima, which has become a deserted island, for a training camp. Meanwhile, on the mainland across the sea, Kawaminami Takaaki, a former member of the Mystery Research Club, receives a letter from Nakamura Seiji, who was supposed to be dead. As he continues his investigation, Konan meets a man named Shimada Kiyoshi, and they start working together. Meanwhile, in the Decagonal House, one of the members of the Mystery Research Club is murdered by someone. "Who on earth is the culprit?" The members become suspicious and start to suspect each other... It will be a week before they can leave the isolated island of Tsunoshima. What is the shocking conclusion beyond imagination that arises from these two stories?
title: Jukkakukan no Satsujin

overview: Burned by Jiang Qian Yao's playboy antics, Hao Sheng Nan and Cai Huan Zhen have been frenemies since college. But when Qian Yao resurfaces to stir up trouble years later, he ignites a new breed of cutthroat competition between Sheng Nan and Huan Zheng, who are both headstrong women focused on succeeding in work and in love. Meanwhile, after seeing too many failed marriages, divorce lawyer Justin Hao becomes increasingly cynical.
title: Marry Me, or Not?

overview: Goddess of Detection is a romantic experiment about searching and dating. Will the bachelor be able to choose a girl by the appearance of her apartment? He will study everything - clothes, books, the contents of closets and shelves. But will the girl agree to a date after a return search at the guy's home? Bloggers Ilya Kuruch, Vika Chuma, and fashion expert Daniil Grachev will comment on what is happening.
title: Богиня сыска

overview: How could an innocent and slightly illegal trip to a classified career end up? Igor, a black digger, diver and just an adventure lover, comes here with his brother and a group of friends in search of an ancient settlement. Diving into a quarry turns into a surprise... Divers find themselves prisoners of the anomalous zone. The zone was classified due to secret experiments, and... people were left to live in their cocoons. Will they be able to get out of a parallel world that exists according to their own laws? ..
title: Погружение

overview: Businessman Chin Tai-hoi calls the shots in the office and at home. Tai-hoi is certain his son Chin Kai-loy is incompetent, so he forces him to make progress by continually putting pressure on him. Although Tai-hoi's lover Hung Mui-kwai has been hinting all kinds of ideas to him, but Tai-hoi still has not promised to honor her. Tai-hoi's daughter Chin Yau-fong goes into business while keeping her father in the dark. Tai-hoi slyly undermines her efforts as he feels betrayed. Tai-hoi is kidnapped. And staff member Chiu Yat-ming comes to his rescue. Tai-hoi becomes suspicious of people around him, so he moves into Yat-ming's home. And he wants Yat-ming to covertly investigate. However, Yat-ming's father Chiu Chi-yung is astonishingly Yau-fong's ex-boyfriend, whom Tai-hoi disliked. Tai-hoi always loves money more than anything else. But his way of thinking somehow changes as he gets along with Yat-ming.
title: Broken Trust

overview: A single woman will meet 14 men who have everything to please her. She is unaware that, as in everyday life, some men she is going to meet are not there for sincere reasons... They are seducers! And if one of them succeeds in being the chosen one of his heart, he will win 20,000 euros. Will our single person succeed in detecting true love and avoiding the trap of seducers?
title: Arnacœur ou prince charmant

overview: Based on the exclusive testimonies of several of them, as well as insights and archive footage, this is a fascinating immersion into the ritualized world of the yakuza, legendary mobsters now in decline.
title: Yakuzas : Les mafieux légendaires au Japon

overview: Each week, chance will designate a participant as the Power Player, who will have all the powers in the house and will decide who sleeps where, who eats what, who has this privilege or that handicap. But he will have to keep his identity secret at all costs. At the end of the week, the Power Player will designate the player who will be eliminated. Unless he unmasks the Power Player, in which case it is the latter who will be eliminated! Between strategies, alliances and low blows, who will be able to tame power?
title: The Power : Qui a le pouvoir ?

overview: After 30 years travelling through the kitchens of France, chef Philippe Etchebest sets out to discover other flavors, other products and other cultures.
title: Un chef au bout du monde avec Philippe Etchebest

overview: Jack, a captain who manages his personal life as poorly as his plane, and Charlie his co-pilot, relegated from a prestigious company to Flywingz, are forced to collaborate. To do this, they will be supported by an astonishing team of cabin crew: the naive Nelly, Nabil, the most unpredictable steward the sky has ever known, Tristan the arriviste, and Armelle, an activist in all battles. An inspection visit that turns into a fiasco, a child who takes the controls of the plane or a safety training session that goes awry: our (almost) always united team of broken arms will try as best they can to manage these absurd situations. And too bad if the methods adopted do not always respect security procedures. Good flight !
title: Terminal

overview: The GIGN, an intervention group of the national gendarmerie, is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2024. Each episode of the series deciphers a daring mission.
title: GIGN, unité d'élite

overview: For more than 10 years now, the people of Marseillais have been living their adventures in the four corners of the world! For Paga and Julien, it's time to delve back into memories... The two friends will review the highlights of all the seasons of the show that changed their lives, and comment on them by giving their version of things and revealing to you unpublished anecdotes… Discover the first reaction of the Marseillais… by the Marseillais!
title: Les Secrets des fratés

overview: The definition of guilt is being responsible for wrongdoing or a crime. In the murder of Molly Ryan, many are guilty in different ways, but only one is truly guilty of her murder. When Natalie's sister Grace becomes the prime suspect in her roommate Molly's murder and popular target for the press and in social media, Natalie leaves her life in Boston and heads to London to defend her. With the help of an ethically questionable ex-pat lawyer Stan Gutterie, Natalie starts to question how innocent her sister may really be as more ugly truths start to emerge. In this one-hour soapy drama, the mystery will twist through all layers of London society – from a posh but depraved sex club and all the way up to the Royal Family itself.
title: Guilt

overview: Two women, young and beautiful, form a strong friendship. Marie de Rohan, Duchess of Chevreuse, lively and cheerful, free in body and mind, who collects adventures, and Anne of Austria, Queen of France, prudish and shy who, married too young and abandoned by her husband the king Louis XIII suffers from neurasthenia.
title: Une amitié dangereuse

overview: The lives of a group of women are suddenly turned upside down by the discovery of the human remains of one of their classmates, who disappeared during a school trip to Majorca twenty-five years earlier.
title: Las Largas Sombras

overview: In 2024/2025, the new UEFA Champions League format, with even more matches, will be broadcast in full on CANAL+ channels. With this in mind, to strengthen its team of commentators, CANAL+ has launched a search for a new voice to commentate on football on its channels. An exceptional recruitment process, in several stages, open for the first time to all football fans. Competitors aged 18 to 64, from all professional and social categories.
title: Au micro

overview: Welcome to Sip & Gossip, the podcast presented by Maghla where we read all your little unspoken secrets.
title: Sip & Gossip

overview: This documentary series aims to reveal and understand education, its challenges, its hopes, its successes, and sometimes its limits. At an age when everything is possible - at this turning point in life - this unique program offers an uncompromising, but empathetic, look at life in a REP (Priority Education Network) middle school. Students and teachers alike will talk about the difficulties as well as the successes encountered throughout this school year.
title: Au cœur du collège, un an à Jean Vilar

overview: Entertainer and musician Pat Shortt and Stockton's Wing frontman Mike Hanrahan, take a musical road trip around Ireland to discover the history behind some of our greatest songs.
title: Songs of Ireland

overview: Mike, Daan, Ivo and Greg are facing a world that has evolved without them. Some are ready to rethink their ways; others try to reaffirm their manhood.
title: Haantjes

overview: Two clans take part in the show - a team of psychics and a team of scientists. They have to fight each other. In these tests they must use only their own methods: scientists - the method of scientific analysis, psychics - superpowers and secret forces of nature! Who will win?
title: Экстрасенсы против ученых

overview: A true and complete life story of the country's most famous psychics. Never before have they been so candid in front of the camera. What is it like to have the gift of foresight and know everything in advance? Why can't they protect their loved ones from misfortune, and which of these superhumans is capable of ordinary tears?
title: Исповедь экстрасенса

overview: Holden, a young man who wakes up from a coma after 12 years, discovers new abilities that propel him into the middle of a dangerous conspiracy. Now Holden must try and figure out what happened to him during those 12 years, how to survive a world that changed while he was gone, and answer the question, why did this happen to him?
title: Beyond

overview: The town of St. Maurice is in an economic crisis until an unlikely cash crop saves the day.
title: The Village Green

overview: I'm Dawan. Since I can remember, I have always had strange dreams about a quiet girl who often played with me in my dreams. One day, a new neighbor moved in, and that led to my family falling apart. My father ran away with the man next door, who turned out to be the father of Khimhan the quiet and small girl from next door. Initially, we were not close at all, but circumstances brought us closer and made us understand each other. However, Khimhan was unaware that while in the real world we were just friends, in my dreams, she and I did things that went far beyond that. So, I kept my feelings concealed because I couldn't let her know. I never realized that in those dreams, I was not the only one dreaming.
title: My Marvellous Dream Is You

overview: Set in 19th century Delhi, our story takes place at a time when technology and science are still in their infancy and modern tools of investigation haven't yet been invented. While Bahadur Shah Zafar II reigns ostensibly, the British might and influence increase each day, and with it, a spate of crimes. As crime multiplies, the police grapple to keep up with the mounting unsolved cases. Under these circumstances, when the Kotwal finds himself in the midst of a felonious mystery, he seeks the help of the only man who can come to his aid, Mirza Jaan Nawaz. Though eccentric in his methods of investigation, Mirza proves himself time and again, unraveling a new mystery with every case. Without the aid of technology, Mirza relies on the most potent tool of all his brains! With an equal measure of intelligence and looks, Mirza Jaan Nawaz knows how to maneuver every situation. But Mirza only has eyes for his love, Zeenat, from whom he often seeks counsel.
title: Dariba Diaries

overview: Four women, all teachers at Munich's Novalis high school, feel the sword of Damocles of the menopause threateningly hover above them - Angelika has hot flashes, Beate uncontrolled emotional outbursts, Cornelia gets panic attacks and Desiree is suffering from nervous exhaustion. However, all four realize that life also continues in this stage of life - albeit on winding paths.
title: Klimawechsel

overview: Join foodie influencer and home baker Naomi Toilalo as she challenges Top Chefs around Aotearoa to create a three course meal out of food she's rescued.
title: Food Rescue Kitchen

overview: Crutch is a Harlem widower whose empty nest plans are put on hold after his millennial son and free-spirited daughter move back home.
title: Crutch
